text: "Commander. I keep circling back to the last Hegemony berth we sat in - nobody asked to see my papers the entire time we were docked. I was assured, repeatedly, that they would."

text: "Commander. There is a Tri-Tachyon concourse still bothering me - every price on it ran to four decimal places, and I never did find anyone who could tell me what the fourth one was for."
"Sometimes I wonder if Draconis could've ever joined the League - doubt it. I think there would always be too great of a divide between their goals and ours... But I think about it."
"Kazeron keeps coming back to me. The decision to arm Athebyne was taken in a building on that rock, by a committee, and minuted. I would give a great deal to read the other items on that agenda."

"Mazalot, still, for some reason. A Luddic majority under a League governor, and nobody on that world could tell me what the original concession actually was. I suspect the arrangement outlived everybody who ever found it objectionable."

"I have not stopped thinking about Fikenhild, Commander. They farm the entire ocean there - not a section of it, the ocean - and I asked a dockhand what the fish were called. He kept giving me names until I told him to stop."

"Vorium has stayed with me, oddly. Nobody visits it who is not there for the gravity assist or the volatiles, and I have now met several of each. None of them had an opinion about the planet itself. I have decided that is the correct opinion to have. Thankful for the asteroid meteorite it is, though."

"Tiamat, again. Contract labor rotated through the extraction sites there on eighteen-month postings, forty cycles back. I have a specific interest in the manifest from one particular rotation. It has never once turned up."

"Nidhogg keeps turning over in my head, Commander. Half of it has never seen a sunset, the other half has never seen a sunrise, and the station log calls both conditions nominal. I find that almost admirable."
"Still thinking about Jormungandr. The storms on it are supposedly visible from three systems over. I have decided not to verify that personally, and I would like credit for the restraint."

"Hel - supposedly there is an old listening post there that logs every hyperspace anomaly within a thousands of light years. Never heard of anyone actually getting stationed there though. Wonder if it's automated?"
